## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**2. Which sectors are leading?**

Industrials strong: MMM (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +4.96%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +8.88% | 1M: +21.58%) ABOVE TREND. Materials strong via DOW (1W: +10.20% | 1M: +27.61%) ABOVE TREND and DD (1W: +9.12% | 1M: +12.83%) ABOVE TREND.

Consumer Discretionary weak: AMZN (1W: -13.27% | 1M: -16.34%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -7.83% | 1M: -22.05%) BELOW TREND. ## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

Top 5: CHTR (1W: +16.66% | 1M: +17.85%) ABOVE TREND; MMM (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +4.96%) ABOVE TREND; DOW (1W: +10.20% | 1M: +27.61%) ABOVE TREND; DD (1W: +9.12% | 1M: +12.83%) ABOVE TREND; DE (1W: +8.88% | 1M: +21.58%) ABOVE TREND. **5. Worst Performing Stocks?**

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W movers: CHTR (1W: +16.66%), MMM (1W: +11.40%), DOW (1W: +10.20%), DD (1W: +9.12%), DE (1W: +8.88%) — cyclical momentum. Major divergence flagged: MSFT (1W: +0.50% | 1M: -13.77%) RECOVERY, AMD (1W: -11.79% | 1M: +5.12%) CORRECTION, INTC (1W: -4.30% | 1M: +3.47%) CORRECTION — MAJOR divergence present; watch for trend breaks and avoid forcing large regime shifts.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed to weak: AAPL (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +5.62%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +4.55% | 1M: +1.99%) ABOVE TREND offset by GOOGL (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.04%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -4.82% | 1M: -21.20%) BELOW TREND and AMD (1W: -11.79% | 1M: +5.12%) CORRECTION. Net weekly tech performance is negative (Technology 1W: -1.01%); internal rotation within the sector.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials are mixed but net positive: JPM (1W: +1.09% | 1M: -3.31%) RECOVERY while SCHW (1W: -4.32% | 1M: -0.92%) BELOW TREND and Visa MA style names soft (V and MA trending lower). Sector 1W: +1.17% — watch for select banks/fintech names to lead vs broader dispersion.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Generally constructive but patchy: PFE (1W: +7.14% | 1M: +10.17%) ABOVE TREND, BMY (1W: +8.70% | 1M: +8.95%) ABOVE TREND and AMGN (1W: +7.70% | 1M: +11.82%) ABOVE TREND offset by UNH (1W: -3.86% | 1M: -20.57%) BELOW TREND and TMO (1W: -5.31% | 1M: -12.78%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: +1.73% — selective healthcare strength around defensive/pharma names.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor cyclicals and energy exposure via Industrials/Materials/Energy names showing strength (DOW (1W: +10.20% | 1M: +27.61%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +8.88% | 1M: +21.58%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +5.47% | 1M: +21.65%) ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to lagging large-cap tech and discretionary risk (GOOGL (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.04%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -13.27% | 1M: -16.34%) BELOW TREND). Style: Value/Cyclical favored given dispersion; monitor tech divergences for any regime change.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: CHTR (1W: +16.66% | 1M: +17.85%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +10.20% | 1M: +27.61%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +7.14% | 1M: +10.17%) ABOVE TREND — catalysts and follow-through to confirm. BEARISH: AMZN (1W: -13.27% | 1M: -16.34%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.04%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -4.82% | 1M: -21.20%) BELOW TREND — watch downside momentum.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Industrials (1W: +4.56%) and Materials (1W: +4.42%) — breadth and top performers confirming. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -1.01%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -0.99%) — continue to monitor leadership rotation.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch NVDA (1W: +4.55% | 1M: +1.99%) ABOVE TREND for weekly continuation above recent breakout to confirm tech re-engagement. Monitor AAPL (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +5.62%) ABOVE TREND for hold of the 1M uptrend as a tech tone setter. Track AMZN (1W: -13.27% | 1M: -16.34%) BELOW TREND for failure to reclaim recent support — breach would increase discretionary downside.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
PFE (+80): Priority review for sBLA noted; price PFE (1W: +7.14% | 1M: +10.17%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. DD (+50): Strong Q4 commentary; DD (1W: +9.12% | 1M: +12.83%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. GOOGL (+50): Tax/AI rules story; GOOGL (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.04%) BELOW TREND — sentiment versus price is diverging, watch for distribution.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
META (-55): EU/child-safety legal headlines; META (1W: -3.03% | 1M: +2.70%) CORRECTION — bearish news contrasts with 1M resilience, monitor. UNH (-45): Revenue outlook concerns; UNH (1W: -3.86% | 1M: -20.57%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed and a higher-risk name. Limited overlap for other high-sentiment names in the provided dataset; prioritize monitoring these confirmed/diverging cases.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with Value/Cyclical tilt. CHTR (1W: +16.66% | 1M: +17.85%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +10.20% | 1M: +27.61%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +5.47% | 1M: +21.65%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk is major large-cap divergence (MSFT RECOVERY, AMD CORRECTION, INTC CORRECTION) and mixed news flows on big tech (GOOGL/META) that could suppress a clear regime shift.
